versions.changelog:
**Major update with modular architecture, expanded resource management, and improved security model.**

- Introduced a fully modular structure: each function in its own file for easier maintenance and extension.
- Extensive new resource management: covers pools, node pools, training jobs, inference services (v1 & v2), notebooks, SWR, VPC, KMS, and LiteServer.
- Security enhancements: credentials are never exposed; in-memory handling only, strict masking and isolation.
- Environment variable-based authentication: seamless in both notebook and local environments.
- Added OBS as primary notebook storage with built-in OBS bucket management features.
- New features include plugin and node configuration template management, comprehensive batch operations, and detailed reference documentation per resource.

- Initial release of ModelArts_Resource_Manager.
- Provides comprehensive management for ModelArts resources: resource overview, training jobs, models, inference services, and notebooks.
- Ensures high security: sensitive data masking, in-memory runtime, no caching or persistence, and internal structure masking on errors.
- Supports actions for listing and creating training jobs, managing models, inference services, and notebooks.
